output:
How it works

Three taps to dinner.

No typing in ingredients, no browsing endless recipes. Just point and cook.

1

📸 Snap

Open your fridge and take a photo. Add your pantry or spice cabinet too — the more it sees, the better it cooks.

2

🔍 Identify

AI vision reads every ingredient across your photos, with a confidence check so it never makes things up.

3

🍽️ Cook

Get 3 real recipes ranked by what you already have, with steps and a tidy shopping list for anything you're missing.

Why you'll love it

Built for real kitchens.

🧠

Recipes invented for you

Not a fixed database — the AI creates dishes around exactly what's on your shelves.

📷

Multi-photo scans

Fridge + pantry + spice rack in one go. It combines everything into a single ingredient list.

🌱

Diet-aware

Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free toggles are respected in every suggestion.

✨

Surprise me

Feeling adventurous? Get the most creative dish your ingredients can pull off.

Ready to raid your fridge?

Turn "there's nothing to eat" into dinner in seconds. What's Cooking is coming soon to the App Store.
